+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+cd "$ROOT"
+
+OUTPUT_PATH=""
+if [[ "${1:-}" == "--output" && -n "${2:-}" ]]; then
+  OUTPUT_PATH=$2
+  shift 2
+fi
+
+if [[ $# -ne 0 ]]; then
+  echo "usage: bash scripts/ci/ci-exunit-timing.test.sh [--output PATH]" >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
+
+for tool in mix node jq; do
+  if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: required tool is missing: $tool" >&2
+    exit 2
+  fi
+done
+
+TMP_ROOT="$(mktemp -d)"
+cleanup() {
+  rm -rf "$TMP_ROOT"
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+export MIX_ENV=test
+export PGUSER="${PGUSER:-postgres}"
+export PGPASSWORD="${PGPASSWORD:-postgres}"
+export PGHOST="${PGHOST:-localhost}"
+
+if command -v pg_isready >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "${PGPORT:-5432}" -U "$PGUSER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: PostgreSQL is not accepting connections at $PGHOST:${PGPORT:-5432}" >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
+
+FOCUS_TEST="test/sigra/planning/ci_timing_formatter_test.exs"
+TIMED_MIX_JS='const { spawnSync } = require("node:child_process");
+const started = process.hrtime.bigint();
+const result = spawnSync("mix", ["test", "test/sigra/planning/ci_timing_formatter_test.exs"], { encoding: "utf8" });
+const elapsedUs = Number((process.hrtime.bigint() - started) / 1000n);
+if (result.stdout) process.stdout.write(result.stdout);
+if (result.stderr) process.stderr.write(result.stderr);
+if (result.error) process.stderr.write(`ci-exunit-timing.test: ${result.error.message}\n`);
+process.stderr.write(`SIGRA_TIMING_ELAPSED_US=${elapsedUs}\n`);

+defmodule Sigra.Test.CITimingFormatter do
+  @moduledoc false
+
+  use GenServer
+
+  @unit "microsecond"
+  @count_keys [:passed, :failed, :skipped, :excluded]
+
+  @doc false
+  def new_state(path, invocation \\ System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION")) do
+    %{
+      path: path,
+      invocation: invocation,
+      tests: [],
+      counts: Map.new(@count_keys, &{&1, 0}),
+      test_duration_sum_us: 0,
+      diagnostics: [],
+      started_at_us: nil,
+      aborted?: false
+    }
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def init(_opts) do
+    path = System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON")
+    state = new_state(path, System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION"))
+
+    case clear_previous_report(path) do
+      :ok ->
+        {:ok, state}
+
+      {:error, reason} ->
+        report_write_error(reason)
+        {:ok, add_diagnostic(state, "previous_output_unavailable")}
+    end
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def handle_cast({:suite_started, _opts}, state) do
+    {:noreply, %{state | started_at_us: System.monotonic_time(:microsecond)}}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:test_finished, %ExUnit.Test{} = test}, state) do
+    id = test_id(test)
+    result = result(test.state)
+    state = update_in(state.counts[result], &(&1 + 1))
+
+    if result == :excluded do
+      {:noreply, state}
+    else
+      case test.time do
+        time when is_integer(time) and time >= 0 ->
+          row = %{
+            invocation: state.invocation,
+            test_id: id,
+            module: inspect(test.module),
+            name: Atom.to_string(test.name),
+            result: Atom.to_string(result),
+            duration_us: time,
+            unit: @unit
+          }
+
+          state =
+            state
+            |> update_in([:tests], &[row | &1])
+            |> update_in([:test_duration_sum_us], &(&1 + time))
+
+          {:noreply, state}
+
+        _ ->
+          {:noreply, add_diagnostic(state, "test_duration_unavailable:#{id}")}
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:max_failures_reached, _}, state) do
+    {:noreply, state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("max_failures_reached")}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast(:max_failures_reached, state) do
+    {:noreply, state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("max_failures_reached")}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:suite_finished, times_us}, state) do
+    report = build_report(state, times_us, true)
+    write_report(state.path, report)
+    {:noreply, state}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:sigquit, _current}, state) do
+    state = state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("suite_interrupted")
+    write_report(state.path, build_report(state, %{}, false))
+    {:noreply, state}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast(_event, state), do: {:noreply, state}
+
+  defp build_report(state, times_us, suite_finished?) do
+    {run_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :run, state.diagnostics)
+    {async_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :async, diagnostics, optional: true)
+    {load_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :load, diagnostics, optional: true)
+
+    suite_elapsed_us =
+      case {state.started_at_us, suite_finished?} do
+        {started_at_us, true} when is_integer(started_at_us) ->
+          max(System.monotonic_time(:microsecond) - started_at_us, 0)
+
+        _ ->
+          nil
+      end
+
+    diagnostics =
+      if is_nil(suite_elapsed_us) and suite_finished? do
+        ["suite_elapsed_unavailable" | diagnostics]
+      else
+        diagnostics
+      end
+
+    %{
+      unit: @unit,
+      invocation: state.invocation,
+      tests: Enum.reverse(state.tests),
+      counts: Map.new(state.counts, fn {key, value} -> {Atom.to_string(key), value} end),
+      passed_count: state.counts.passed,
+      failed_count: state.counts.failed,
+      skipped_count: state.counts.skipped,
+      excluded_count: state.counts.excluded,
+      suite_elapsed_us: suite_elapsed_us,
+      run_us: run_us,
+      async_us: async_us,
+      load_us: load_us,
+      test_duration_sum_us: state.test_duration_sum_us,
+      complete: suite_finished? and not state.aborted? and diagnostics == [],
+      diagnostics: Enum.reverse(diagnostics)
+    }
+  end
+
+  defp measured_time(times_us, key, diagnostics, opts \\ []) do
+    case {Map.get(times_us, key), opts[:optional]} do
+      {value, _optional} when is_integer(value) and value >= 0 ->
+        {value, diagnostics}
+
+      {nil, true} ->
+        {nil, diagnostics}
+
+      _ ->
+        {nil, ["#{key}_time_unavailable" | diagnostics]}
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp result(nil), do: :passed
+  defp result({:failed, _}), do: :failed
+  defp result({:invalid, _}), do: :failed
+  defp result({:skipped, _}), do: :skipped
+  defp result({:excluded, _}), do: :excluded
+  defp result(_), do: :failed
+
+  defp test_id(%ExUnit.Test{module: module, name: name}),
+    do: "#{inspect(module)}.#{Atom.to_string(name)}"
+
+  defp add_diagnostic(state, diagnostic),
+    do: update_in(state.diagnostics, &[diagnostic | &1])
+
+  defp clear_previous_report(path) when is_binary(path) and path != "" do
+    case File.rm(path) do
+      :ok -> :ok
+      {:error, :enoent} -> :ok
+      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp clear_previous_report(_path), do: :ok
+
+  defp write_report(path, report) when is_binary(path) and path != "" do
+    temporary_path = path <> ".tmp." <> Integer.to_string(System.unique_integer([:positive]))
+    contents = Jason.encode!(report)
+
+    case File.write(temporary_path, contents, [:binary, :exclusive]) do
+      :ok ->
+        case File.rename(temporary_path, path) do
+          :ok ->
+            :ok
+
+          {:error, reason} ->
+            File.rm(temporary_path)
+            report_write_error(reason)
+        end
+
+      {:error, reason} ->
+        report_write_error(reason)
+    end
+  rescue
+    _ -> report_write_error(:encoding_failed)
+  end
+
+  defp write_report(_path, _report), do: report_write_error(:output_path_missing)
+
+  defp report_write_error(reason) do
+    diagnostic =
+      if reason == :output_path_missing, do: "output_path_missing", else: "write_failed"
+
+    message =
+      Jason.encode!(%{
+        complete: false,
+        diagnostic: diagnostic,
+        reason: reason |> :file.format_error() |> List.to_string()
+      })
+
+    IO.puts(:stderr, "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON: #{message}")
+
+    :error
+  end
+end

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+cd "$ROOT"
+
+OUTPUT_PATH=""
+if [[ "${1:-}" == "--output" && -n "${2:-}" ]]; then
+  OUTPUT_PATH=$2
+  shift 2
+fi
+
+if [[ $# -ne 0 ]]; then
+  echo "usage: bash scripts/ci/ci-exunit-timing.test.sh [--output PATH]" >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
+
+for tool in mix node jq; do
+  if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: required tool is missing: $tool" >&2
+    exit 2
+  fi
+done
+
+TMP_ROOT="$(mktemp -d)"
+cleanup() {
+  rm -rf "$TMP_ROOT"
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+export MIX_ENV=test
+export PGUSER="${PGUSER:-postgres}"
+export PGPASSWORD="${PGPASSWORD:-postgres}"
+export PGHOST="${PGHOST:-localhost}"
+
+if command -v pg_isready >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "${PGPORT:-5432}" -U "$PGUSER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: PostgreSQL is not accepting connections at $PGHOST:${PGPORT:-5432}" >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
+
+FOCUS_TEST="test/sigra/planning/ci_timing_formatter_test.exs"

+const started = process.hrtime.bigint();
+const result = spawnSync("mix", ["test", "test/sigra/planning/ci_timing_formatter_test.exs"], { encoding: "utf8" });
+const elapsedUs = Number((process.hrtime.bigint() - started) / 1000n);
+if (result.stdout) process.stdout.write(result.stdout);
+if (result.stderr) process.stderr.write(result.stderr);
+if (result.error) process.stderr.write(`ci-exunit-timing.test: ${result.error.message}\n`);
+process.stderr.write(`SIGRA_TIMING_ELAPSED_US=${elapsedUs}\n`);
+process.exit(result.status === null ? 1 : result.status);'
+
+PROBE_CODE='unless Code.ensure_loaded?(Sigra.Test.CITimingFormatter) do
+  Code.require_file("test/support/ci_timing_formatter.ex")
+end
+
+formatters =
+  if System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON") in [nil, ""] do
+    [ExUnit.CLIFormatter]
+  else
+    [ExUnit.CLIFormatter, Sigra.Test.CITimingFormatter]
+  end
+
+ExUnit.start(formatters: formatters)
+
+defmodule Sigra.CITimingProcessProbe do
+  use ExUnit.Case
+
+  test "probe keeps the original ExUnit result" do
+    if System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_FAIL") == "1" do
+      assert 2 == 1
+    else
+      assert 1 == 1
+    end
+  end
+end'
+
+run_probe() {
+  local log_path=$1
+  shift
+  local status
+
+  if "$@" >"$log_path" 2>&1; then
+    status=0
+  else
+    status=$?
+  fi
+
+  printf '%s\n' "$status"
+}
+
+has_write_diagnostic() {
+  local log_path=$1
+  local diagnostic
+
+  diagnostic="$(sed -n 's/^SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON: //p' "$log_path" | tail -n 1)"
+  [[ -n "$diagnostic" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$diagnostic" | jq -e '.complete == false and .diagnostic == "write_failed" and (.reason | type == "string")' >/dev/null
+}
+
+run_focus_sample() {

+  local sample=$2
+  local log_path=$3
+  local output_path=$4
+  local status elapsed_us
+  local -a command
+
+  if [[ "$mode" == "with" ]]; then
+    command=(env "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON=$output_path" SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION=instrumentation_test node -e "$TIMED_MIX_JS")

+  fi
+
+  if "${command[@]}" >"$log_path" 2>&1; then
+    status=0
+  else
+    status=$?
+  fi
+
+  if [[ "$status" -ne 0 ]]; then
+    cat "$log_path" >&2
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: focused suite failed in $mode sample $sample (exit $status)" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+
+  elapsed_us="$(sed -n 's/^SIGRA_TIMING_ELAPSED_US=//p' "$log_path" | tail -n 1)"

+    cat "$log_path" >&2
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: missing elapsed microseconds for $mode sample $sample" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+
+  if [[ "$mode" == "with" ]]; then
+    if [[ ! -s "$output_path" ]] || ! jq -e '.complete == true and .unit == "microsecond" and .invocation == "instrumentation_test" and (.tests | length == 3) and all(.tests[]; .invocation == "instrumentation_test")' "$output_path" >/dev/null; then

+      echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: instrumented sample $sample did not produce a complete three-test report" >&2
+      return 1
+    fi
+  else
+    if [[ -e "$output_path" ]] || rg -q 'SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON:' "$log_path"; then
+      cat "$log_path" >&2
+      echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: uninstrumented sample $sample produced timing output" >&2
+      return 1
+    fi
+  fi
+
+  if ! rg -q '3 tests, 0 failures' "$log_path"; then
+    cat "$log_path" >&2
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: focused suite $mode sample $sample did not preserve normal ExUnit output" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+
+  printf '%s\n' "$elapsed_us"

+PASS_LOG="$TMP_ROOT/pass.log"
+printf '%s\n' '{"complete":true,"unit":"microsecond","tests":[]}' > "$PASS_PATH"
+PASS_STATUS="$(run_probe "$PASS_LOG" env \
+  "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON=$PASS_PATH" \
+  "MIX_ENV=$MIX_ENV" "PGUSER=$PGUSER" "PGPASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD" "PGHOST=$PGHOST" \
+  mix run --no-start -e "$PROBE_CODE")"

+if [[ "$PASS_STATUS" -ne 0 ]] || ! jq -e '.complete == true and .passed_count == 1 and .failed_count == 0 and (.tests | length == 1) and .tests[0].test_id == "Sigra.CITimingProcessProbe.test probe keeps the original ExUnit result" and .tests[0].result == "passed" and (.tests[0].duration_us >= 0)' "$PASS_PATH" >/dev/null; then

+NO_OPT_IN_LOG="$TMP_ROOT/no-opt-in.log"
+NO_OPT_IN_STATUS="$(run_probe "$NO_OPT_IN_LOG" env -u SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON \
+  "MIX_ENV=$MIX_ENV" "PGUSER=$PGUSER" "PGPASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD" "PGHOST=$PGHOST" \

+defmodule Sigra.Test.CITimingFormatter do
+  @moduledoc false
+
+  use GenServer
+
+  @unit "microsecond"
+  @count_keys [:passed, :failed, :skipped, :excluded]
+
+  @doc false
+  def new_state(path, invocation \\ System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION")) do
+    %{
+      path: path,
+      invocation: invocation,
+      tests: [],
+      counts: Map.new(@count_keys, &{&1, 0}),
+      test_duration_sum_us: 0,
+      diagnostics: [],
+      started_at_us: nil,
+      aborted?: false
+    }
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def init(_opts) do
+    path = System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON")
+    state = new_state(path, System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION"))
+
+    case clear_previous_report(path) do
+      :ok ->
+        {:ok, state}
+
+      {:error, reason} ->
+        report_write_error(reason)
+        {:ok, add_diagnostic(state, "previous_output_unavailable")}
+    end
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def handle_cast({:suite_started, _opts}, state) do
+    {:noreply, %{state | started_at_us: System.monotonic_time(:microsecond)}}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:test_finished, %ExUnit.Test{} = test}, state) do
+    id = test_id(test)
+    result = result(test.state)
+    state = update_in(state.counts[result], &(&1 + 1))
+
+    if result == :excluded do
+      {:noreply, state}
+    else
+      case test.time do
+        time when is_integer(time) and time >= 0 ->
+          row = %{
+            invocation: state.invocation,
+            test_id: id,
+            module: inspect(test.module),
+            name: Atom.to_string(test.name),
+            result: Atom.to_string(result),
+            duration_us: time,
+            unit: @unit
+          }
+
+          state =
+            state
+            |> update_in([:tests], &[row | &1])
+            |> update_in([:test_duration_sum_us], &(&1 + time))
+
+          {:noreply, state}
+
+        _ ->
+          {:noreply, add_diagnostic(state, "test_duration_unavailable:#{id}")}
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:max_failures_reached, _}, state) do
+    {:noreply, state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("max_failures_reached")}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast(:max_failures_reached, state) do
+    {:noreply, state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("max_failures_reached")}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:suite_finished, times_us}, state) do
+    report = build_report(state, times_us, true)
+    write_report(state.path, report)
+    {:noreply, state}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:sigquit, _current}, state) do
+    state = state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("suite_interrupted")
+    write_report(state.path, build_report(state, %{}, false))
+    {:noreply, state}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast(_event, state), do: {:noreply, state}
+
+  defp build_report(state, times_us, suite_finished?) do
+    {run_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :run, state.diagnostics)
+    {async_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :async, diagnostics, optional: true)
+    {load_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :load, diagnostics, optional: true)
+
+    suite_elapsed_us =
+      case {state.started_at_us, suite_finished?} do
+        {started_at_us, true} when is_integer(started_at_us) ->
+          max(System.monotonic_time(:microsecond) - started_at_us, 0)
+
+        _ ->
+          nil
+      end
+
+    diagnostics =
+      if is_nil(suite_elapsed_us) and suite_finished? do
+        ["suite_elapsed_unavailable" | diagnostics]
+      else
+        diagnostics
+      end
+
+    %{
+      unit: @unit,
+      invocation: state.invocation,
+      tests: Enum.reverse(state.tests),
+      counts: Map.new(state.counts, fn {key, value} -> {Atom.to_string(key), value} end),
+      passed_count: state.counts.passed,
+      failed_count: state.counts.failed,
+      skipped_count: state.counts.skipped,
+      excluded_count: state.counts.excluded,
+      suite_elapsed_us: suite_elapsed_us,
+      run_us: run_us,
+      async_us: async_us,
+      load_us: load_us,
+      test_duration_sum_us: state.test_duration_sum_us,
+      complete: suite_finished? and not state.aborted? and diagnostics == [],
+      diagnostics: Enum.reverse(diagnostics)
+    }
+  end
+
+  defp measured_time(times_us, key, diagnostics, opts \\ []) do
+    case {Map.get(times_us, key), opts[:optional]} do
+      {value, _optional} when is_integer(value) and value >= 0 ->
+        {value, diagnostics}
+
+      {nil, true} ->
+        {nil, diagnostics}
+
+      _ ->
+        {nil, ["#{key}_time_unavailable" | diagnostics]}
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp result(nil), do: :passed
+  defp result({:failed, _}), do: :failed
+  defp result({:invalid, _}), do: :failed
+  defp result({:skipped, _}), do: :skipped
+  defp result({:excluded, _}), do: :excluded
+  defp result(_), do: :failed
+
+  defp test_id(%ExUnit.Test{module: module, name: name}),
+    do: "#{inspect(module)}.#{Atom.to_string(name)}"
+
+  defp add_diagnostic(state, diagnostic),
+    do: update_in(state.diagnostics, &[diagnostic | &1])
+
+  defp clear_previous_report(path) when is_binary(path) and path != "" do
+    case File.rm(path) do
+      :ok -> :ok
+      {:error, :enoent} -> :ok
+      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp clear_previous_report(_path), do: :ok
+
+  defp write_report(path, report) when is_binary(path) and path != "" do
+    temporary_path = path <> ".tmp." <> Integer.to_string(System.unique_integer([:positive]))
+    contents = Jason.encode!(report)
+
+    case File.write(temporary_path, contents, [:binary, :exclusive]) do
+      :ok ->
+        case File.rename(temporary_path, path) do
+          :ok ->
+            :ok
+
+          {:error, reason} ->
+            File.rm(temporary_path)
+            report_write_error(reason)
+        end
+
+      {:error, reason} ->
+        report_write_error(reason)
+    end
+  rescue
+    _ -> report_write_error(:encoding_failed)
+  end
+
+  defp write_report(_path, _report), do: report_write_error(:output_path_missing)
+
+  defp report_write_error(reason) do
+    diagnostic =
+      if reason == :output_path_missing, do: "output_path_missing", else: "write_failed"
+
+    message =
+      Jason.encode!(%{
+        complete: false,
+        diagnostic: diagnostic,
+        reason: reason |> :file.format_error() |> List.to_string()
+      })
+
+    IO.puts(:stderr, "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON: #{message}")
+
+    :error
+  end
+end
